definitions: To hit something hard, causing damage or injury.
To make a loud noise as a result of hitting something.
To fail suddenly and dramatically (e.g., a business, a computer system).
To go to sleep very quickly because you are very tired.
To attend a party or event without an invitation.
examples: The car crashed into a tree.
The waves crashed against the shore.
I'm so tired, I'm just going to crash.
They tried to crash the wedding.
